explanation: All three integrands and their partial derivatives are continuous on a closed parameter neighborhood around each allowed t. The derivatives are 1/(2√(x+t)), x(x²-t²)/(x²+t²)², and 1/(x-t)². Their denominators never vanish for x∈[0,1] under the respective restrictions t>0, t>0, and t>1. Thus differentiation under the integral sign is valid for all three.
